testemonials.title: Testimonials
testemonials.intro: Real feedback from guests who came for padel, discovered Spain with locals, and left with a trip their friends still talk about.

items.quote: They went above and beyond with every aspect of the trip. They were always available, regularly checking that everything was going smoothly and making sure we were enjoying ourselves. Everything was perfectly organised, and we had an amazing experience.
items.name: Monique

items.quote: Charlie, who runs the trips, is very friendly and organised and, having lived in Seville for 5 years, he has an in-depth knowledge of the city. The hotel is very comfortable and right in the heart of the old town, a minute's walk from the Cathedral. Each morning we were taken by taxi to the padel club around 15–20 minutes away. The club has indoor and outdoor courts and friendly coaches who all speak good English. It also has a gym and a pleasant bar serving food and drink. It's a very well organised place, but it's friendly, and not remotely corporate in its feel. In the afternoon you can either play more padel or wander round Seville, as you can in the evening when the old town is buzzing and very convivial. It must be one of the best cities in Europe. The whole trip is a perfect mix of sport and culture, and the Friday night tapas tour is a particular highlight. I can't recommend it enough.
items.name: Harry

items.quote: This trip was really fabulous. Nice clean hotel in a great central location near the cathedral. On Tuesday evening we had coaching at the iconico club in Seville with a great coach and later went out with Charlie to a great old tapas restaurant which was delicious. Wednesday we had more coaching which has stood me in good stead I'm happy to report. Had lunch at iconico and went back to explore the city before our tapas tour in the evening. I must say Charlie did all he could to make the experience really honest and very informative. On the Friday we played in the socials with local players and it was the highlight of my holiday. Really enjoyed playing against some great players on the fabulous courts. I would recommend Vibra Travel and would do it again. Thank you.
items.name: Stuart

items.quote: Since I came back from Spain my padel mates all say I have improved my game! So I'm really grateful, I learnt so much.
items.name: Stuart

items.quote: Loved my time with Vibra travel in Seville. The tapas tour was a real highlight with great food and amazing insights into the culture of this beautiful city. The padel club was one of the best I've ever seen with high quality coaching and a really fun and well organised tournament to finish. Overall a great experience.
items.name: Neil Adebowale
items.meta: Risk HQ · UK Padel Insurance Providers · Sevilla, January 2026

items.quote: I love Sevilla, so it was great to come back and experience the city on a padel trip. Iconico is an incredible club with a really friendly atmosphere, and Sevilla itself is, as always, a fantastic city to explore. Watching Sevilla FC was a fantastic experience and made the trip even more memorable.
items.name: Gabriel

items.quote: I came on the trip with my son and we had a brilliant time. The padel was fantastic, but we enjoyed the food and exploring the local area just as much. The tapas bars were a real highlight, and the countryside restaurant overlooking the national park was an amazing experience. A great mix of padel, food and getting out and experiencing Spain.
items.name: Robert Gold
